thread:
maria: Heads up — seeing a new failure mode in us-west2 where warmnodes leave GPU slots 'in-use' after a brief network flap. Pods recreate but scheduler treats the slot as occupied (slot ghosting).

Tom: Yea this one shows up after a conntrack/egress blip; kubelet marks PodTerminated but the node-level KV cache still has refs. Quick symptom dump: pods Pending with message 'no matching free gpu-slot'.

maria: snippet from node logs:
```
I 2026-03-22T08:12:41Z node-agent: lease renew failed: kvcache: write lock timeout\ngpu-manager: hold_count=2, last_release=2026-03-22T08:11:02Z
```

infra-bot: Alert: warmnode-ghost-detect triggered on warmpool-usw2-azc (3 matches) :rotating_light:

ash: Quick Q — are these pods using gang/affinity? If so, scheduler will avoid placing on other nodes because partial gang scheduling sees slot as reserved.

Tom: Most are small-gang training pods with affinity:rack and toleration for taint `warmnode=true:NoSchedule`. When the node briefly returned NotReady the agent didn't run the cache GC.

maria: Workaround that helped manually:
1) annotate node: `kubectl annotate node N slot-gc=true`
2) run job to call node-agent API `/internal/clear-kv?force=true` or run `sudo systemctl restart gpu-kv-cleaner` on the node
That cleared references and scheduler resumed placements.

ash: Long-term: two ideas — add a drain hook to force kvcache GC on reboot/drain, and lower warmnode TTL so stale reservations don't block.

sre-lead: Tradeoff: lowering warmnode TTL from 30m -> 10m will increase provisioning churn and cost ~8-12% during peak. Need measurement.

Tom: Implementation note: a preStop won't always run on kernel OOM or sudden disconnects, so we need agent-side robust GC that detects dead kubelet leases and reclaims slots after Xs of missing heartbeats.

maria: Proposed temporary change: deploy a canary in us-west2c — agent GC threshold from 15s -> 10s on heartbeat miss, plus a drain hook that calls `nvidia-smi --gpu-reset` safe path. Ash, can you queue?

ash: I'll schedule a 2h canary window tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC with rollout guard. Will also add metric `kvcache.stuck_slots` to datadog and alert at >5/min.

Tom: Also add scheduler metric for 'occupied_slots_without_pod' so we can correlate.

maria: Command to surface stuck slots for ops folks:
```
kubectl get pods -A -o jsonpath="{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.spec.nodeName} {.metadata.annotations.gpuSlotStatus}{"\n"}{end}" | grep stuck
```

sre-lead: If canary looks good, we'll roll to other AZs but keep warm TTL conservative. Also create a runbook: quick remediation steps (annotate+run clear job) + who's oncall.

maria: filing ticket INFRA-4321 and adding runbook draft. Thanks — tracking in the ticket for next-week fix. :thumbsup:
